title: Validation service: let an online AI check a model.json (REST page or MCP connector) -- npdev validator
body:
`npdev validator serve` (= `python NPDevMcp/validation_service.py`) runs a local stdlib HTTP service on 127.0.0.1:8780 that validates the CONTENT of ONE model.json with the real warm-jar validator and answers contract `npdev-validation-service.v1`: `status` passed|warning|failed (the validator ran) or rejected (bad input: invalid_json with line/column, not_an_object, too_large, busy, validator_unavailable...), `summary`, `nextStep` (one sentence), `diagnostics` (errors first, empty fields omitted, 50 by default, `maxDiagnostics` up to 500) and `truncated`. `npdev validator doctor` says whether it can start; it refuses to start without npdev-ai-tools.jar (the Gradle fallback is slow and locks).

Path A: `GET /` is a page (paste, drop, `#model=<urlencoded>` / `#model64=<base64url>`, `?modelUrl=`); the result is the console line `NPDEV_VALIDATION_RESULT {json}`, `<pre id="npdev-result">`, the tab title and `window.npdevLastResult`; `POST /api/validate` takes the model as body (Content-Type application/json or text/plain, or the envelope {"model": {...}}). Path B (`--mcp`): stateless Streamable HTTP at `/mcp/<secret>` offering only npdev_validate, npdev_core_context, npdev_search_examples, npdev_search_fix, npdev_check_support, npdev_get_schema (20 diagnostics by default); `scripts/ai/Start-ValidatorTunnel.ps1` starts an ngrok tunnel on your free fixed domain (-NgrokDomain, remembered in tunnel.json) and prints the connector URL, which never changes so the connector is added once; without a domain it falls back to a cloudflared quick tunnel whose URL changes every run.

Limits (v1): one file only (no $ref fragments, no config.json, no remote packs), 2 MB, two validations at once, journal off unless --capture. A `failed` status is a successful tool call: loop on the diagnostics until passed or warning.
